+5V.why: bus B's 5 V from motor_ctrl J2 / J6, behind its switch [motor_ctrl.+5V_BUSB: U6.6 (OUT) can reach its supply +5V]

+5V_OUT.why: the next board's 5 V: +5V through Q1 [= +5V+0]

BOOT0.why: U3.44 (io) can reach its supply +3V3; through R17

CAN_H.why: bus B: 5 V nodes; nothing above 5 V in its cable; transient = the ESD5B5.0 clamps' maximum breakdown (motor_ctrl D4 / D5, and each lever board's own)

CAN_L.why: bus B: 5 V nodes; nothing above 5 V in its cable; transient = the ESD5B5.0 clamps' maximum breakdown (motor_ctrl D4 / D5, and each lever board's own)

CAN_RX.why: U2.4 (R) can reach its supply +3V3_CAN; U3.45 (io) can reach its supply +3V3

SENS_MISO.why: U3.16 (io) can reach its supply +3V3; U4.7 (out) can reach its supply +3V3

USB_DM.why: USBFS D- through U5, joined only in USB mode; 5 V only with a harness fault

USB_DP.why: USBFS D+ through U5 (VOH 3.6 V max, USB 2.0 7.1.1), joined only in USB mode; 5 V only with a harness fault

XCVR_EN_N.why: U3.40 (io) can reach its supply +3V3; through R11
